integrity: Proof is analytic; packaged verify.py gives exact-rational finite cross-checks and secondary numerical quadrature, not an independent or infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic 2x2 real SPD matrices, one-column randomized subspace iteration, squared Frobenius error, all finite nonnegative integer q; excludes oversampling, higher dimensions, floating point, spectral-norm claims. Undiscovered equivalent calculations remain possible.
title: Sharp angular crossover between Gaussian and Rademacher one-column subspace iteration
